description: Signed-out 'Choose Developer' (from /pricing) goes to /console/billing then /sign-in?redirect_url=https://agentdrive.xyz/console/billing. The return path is kept (good), but the form says 'Welcome back! Please sign in to continue' with no mention of billing or plans, and a new visitor sees 'Welcome back'.
expected: Context line such as 'Sign in to choose a plan' and a visible sign-up path for new visitors.
actual: Generic sign-in; the sign-up route is a small link under the card.
suggested_fix: Show context from redirect_url and say 'New here? Create an account' prominently.

description: Bare /connect while signed out shows the ordinary sign-in form with no explanation that this is the agent approval page or that the agent's code is needed afterwards. The signed-in bare /connect (code entry) was not walked.
expected: Heading or line such as 'Sign in to connect an agent'.
actual: Identical to /sign-in; only the header links carry redirect_url=%2Fconnect.
suggested_fix: Add a context line on sign-in when redirect_url is /connect.

description: Sign-up and sign-in repeat the alternative-route link three times: header 'Sign in', card footer 'Already have an account? Sign in', and the line below the card 'Already have an account? Sign in · Pricing · Docs'.
actual: Three links to the same destination on one screen.
suggested_fix: Remove the line below the card or keep only the Clerk footer.
